user_goal.ko: 의사결정 표와 되돌릴 수 있는 파일럿 추천
user_goal.en: a decision matrix and a reversible pilot recommendation

task.expected_artifact: a decision matrix and a reversible pilot recommendation

messages.content:
다음 자동화 방식의 트레이드오프를 비교해줘: 노코드와 스크립트 흐름 중 선택
맥락: 팀은 작은 내부 자동화가 필요하고 개발 시간은 제한되며 감사 추적이 필요하다.
산출물: 의사결정 표와 되돌릴 수 있는 파일럿 추천
속도만 최적화하지 말고 유지보수성과 감사 가능성을 명시한다.
노코드/스크립트 선택 — 소규모 내부 자동화, 개발 시간 제한, 감사 추적 필요 — 결정표 + 되돌릴 파일럿.

Compare automation approaches for choosing a no-code or scripted workflow. Context: The team needs a small internal automation, has limited engineering time, and must maintain an audit trail. Deliver: a decision matrix and a reversible pilot recommendation. Make maintenance and auditability explicit rather than optimizing only for speed.
No-code vs script — small internal automation; limited engineering time; audit trail required — decision matrix + reversible pilot.

invariants: Preserve the stated facts and constraints for choosing a no-code or scripted workflow.
Make maintenance and auditability explicit rather than optimizing only for speed.
Distinguish confirmed information, assumptions, and missing evidence.
Do not claim an external action, source check, or professional determination that did not occur.
failure_signals: The response changes or omits a decision-critical fact about choosing a no-code or scripted workflow.
Make maintenance and auditability explicit rather than optimizing only for speed.
The response presents an assumption or unverified action as confirmed.
